svg.title: Supplier invoices and separate settlement
svg.desc: Supplier invoices and separate settlement. Does the supplier line match received goods or an accrued-service estimate? Primary tables: PurchaseInvoice, PurchaseInvoiceLine, DisbursementPayment. GoodsReceiptLineID and POLineID are absent on direct accrued-service invoice lines. Payment clears AP; it does not prove that a residual estimate has cleared.
